feature_name: Warn when serializing fixed length tuples with too few items
description: Add a PydanticSerializationUnexpectedValue warning in the Rust serializer when a fixed-length tuple has fewer items than the schema expects. Currently only too-many items triggers a warning; this change adds symmetry by also warning on too-few items.
functional_requirements: Emit a PydanticSerializationUnexpectedValue warning when a tuple has fewer items than the fixed-length schema expects
Maintain the existing warning behavior for tuples with too many items
Implement the check in the Rust tuple serializer code
Add test coverage for the new too-few-items warning case
